# Coconut water

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="coconut-water-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="coconut-water-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="coconut-water-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Coconut water in the HMI library has 178 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium, tin, uranium, Co and Cu from 5 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahmad M, Junayed M, Badsha MR, Quader MFB, Morshed S · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Occurrence of Heavy Metal in Green Coconut Water and Surface Seawater of the Sea Beach Areas of Bangladesh</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Health Dynamics 2024; Form, basis and where the coconut water was sampled; reporting limits decide how many results are non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahmad M, Junayed M, Badsha MR, Quader MFB, Morshed S · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Occurrence of Heavy Metal in Green Coconut Water and Surface Seawater of the Sea Beach Areas of Bangladesh</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Health Dynamics 2024; 1(1): 3-10</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Jonnalagadda PR, Medithi S, Lari S, Chinthanuri K, Kasa YD, Nagaraju R, Vanka J, Kodali V · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants">Assessment of chemical contaminants in fresh and packaged tender coconut (Cocos nucifera) water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Czech Journal of Food Sciences 40(2): 154-162 (2022)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</li>

Ask for lot results with a quantification limit well below the limit that applies in the destination market.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahmad M, Junayed M, Badsha MR, Quader MFB, Morshed S · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Occurrence of Heavy Metal in Green Coconut Water and Surface Seawater of the Sea Beach Areas of Bangladesh</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Health Dynamics 2024; Results stay on the basis each source reports: as sold or fresh weight, dry weight, or unstated. Dry-weight, as-sold and unstated results are never pooled, and no moisture conversion is applied.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-coconut-water" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-coconut-water-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of coconut water, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. At least four reference units and a definitely positive Q1 to Q3 spread are required. This is a display eligibility rule, not statistical validation.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Limitations</p><p>FDA Total Diet Study is the only compatible sampling family for coconut water, as sold on this basis in the completed coconut water ledger, so this single-family reference cannot represent other markets. Reporting regions and purchase markets are not growing areas. Non-detects with differing limits widen the bounds. <a id="trade-offs-and-failure-modes"></a>
## Trade-offs and limits of controls

<a id="hmi-ing-022"></a>
<a id="can-an-intervention-increase-another-contaminant-or-redistribute-contamination-to-a-by-product"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-023"></a>

<a id="hmi-ing-024"></a>
<a id="what-costs-constraints-adverse-effects-or-failure-modes-are-documented-and-which-are-unknown"></a>

Metals do not move together, so a lot that passes a lead limit says little about cadmium, arsenic or nickel unless those are tested as well.

<a id="universal-faqs"></a>
## Coconut water FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-coconut-water" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-coconut-water" data-question="What heavy metals are found in coconut water?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in coconut water?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The library reports lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, nickel, chromium, tin, uranium, Co and Cu in coconut water, most often lead, cadmium and total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Ahmad M, Junayed M, Badsha MR, Quader MFB, Morshed S · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Occurrence of Heavy Metal in Green Coconut Water and Surface Seawater of the Sea Beach Areas of Bangladesh</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Health Dynamics 2024; 1(1): 3-10</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/ahmad2024-bangladesh-green-coconut-water-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Jonnalagadda PR, Medithi S, Lari S, Chinthanuri K, Kasa YD, Nagaraju R, Vanka J, Kodali V · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants">Assessment of chemical contaminants in fresh and packaged tender coconut (Cocos nucifera) water</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Czech Journal of Food Sciences 40(2): 154-162 (2022)</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/jonnalagadda2022-india-tender-coconut-water-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> WHO GEMS/Food submissions reported cadmium in coconut water, juice from 17 results in 1 reporting region, with subgroup medians below 0.3 µg/kg, mostly non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>
